title: Event-Loop Drift
tagline: Compare how different timer strategies trade precision against CPU overhead under jittery loads.

curves.label: Fixed-Interval Poll
curves.code: tick(){ for(let k=0;k<n;k++){ now=clock(); if(now>=t[k]) fire(k) } }
curves.name: Fixed-Interval Poll

curves.label: Hierarchical Timing Wheel
curves.code: schedule(t){ bucket=selectWheelSlot(t); wheel[bucket].push(t) } onTick(){ for(x of wheel[curr]) fire(x) }
curves.name: Hierarchical Timing Wheel

curves.label: Delay-Cancel Wheel
curves.code: cancel(id){ markDeleted(id); if(bucketEmptySoon) compactBucket(bucket) } tick(){ skipMarked() }
curves.name: Delay-Cancel Wheel
